careers.title: Baara DeHub la
careers.subtitle: Don jɛkulu la min bɛ social media min tɛ sigi yɔrɔ kelen na, o siniko jɔ
careers.intro: An bɛ mɔgɔ ɲɛnamaw ɲini minnu b'a fɛ ka kɛ social media kɔrɔ kura dɔ ye — min bɛ dabalibagaw ni jɛkuluw bila fɔlɔ. Baara bɛɛ bɛ kɛ yɔrɔjan na ni waati nɔgɔyalenw ye.
careers.negotiableSalaryOTE: Sara min bɛ se ka sɔsɔ + OTE Komisɔn
careers.bdmAbout: I kɛlen DeHub ka Jago Yiriwali Ɲɛmɔgɔ dɔ ye, i bɛna kɛ an ka jɛɲɔgɔnya fɛɛrɛ fanga dɔ ye. I ka baara ye ka sosiyetew ɲini, ka kuma u fɛ, ka bɛnkanw kɛ u fɛ Web2 ni Web3 kɔnɔ — ka bɔ tulonkɛ studiow ni fɛn platformw la ka se blockchain porozɛw ni DeFi protocolw ma. Nin ye OTE (On-Target Earnings) komisɔn baara ye: ni i ye baara kɛ kosɛbɛ, i bɛ wari caman sɔrɔ. Baara ka nɔgɔn, sosiyetew, porozɛw, jɛkuluw walima konti belebelebaw lana DeHub kan, ka i sara sɔrɔ.
careers.bdmResp1: Jɛɲɔgɔnya nafamaw ɲini ka u sabati ni Web2 ni Web3 sosiyetew ye minnu bɛ bɛn DeHub ka laɲini ma
careers.bdmResp2: Jɛɲɔgɔn, dɛmɛbaga ani ɲɔgɔn fara sababu nataw lisi jɔ k'a ɲɛminɛ
careers.bdmResp3: DeHub jira baarakɛyɔrɔ ɲɔgɔnyew, konferansiw ani ɲɔgɔnye internɛti kanw na
careers.bdmResp4: Jɛɲɔgɔnya sariyaw, tɔnɔ tilali cogoyaw ani jago ɲɔgɔn fɛ bɛnkanw sɔsɔ
careers.bdmResp5: Baara kɛ ni porodui ni jago jɛkuluw ye ka kanpaɲi ni ɲɔgɔn fara baaraw labɛn ɲɔgɔn fɛ
careers.bdmReq1: Dɔnniya jiralen jago yiriwali, jɛɲɔgɔnyaw walima feereli la tekinoloji, tulonkɛ walima Web3 kɔnɔ
careers.bdmReq2: Ni i ka jɛkulu barikama bɛ crypto/Web3 walima dabalibagaw ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔ, o ye nafa belebeleba ye
careers.bdmReq3: Kumakan ni sɔsɔli seko ɲuman — i bɛ se ka bɛnkanw kɛ ani ka jɛɲɔgɔnya mɛnnenw jɔ
careers.bdmReq4: I yɛrɛ bɛ i yɛrɛ lawuli ani i bɛ se ka baara kɛ i kelen na yɔrɔjan na
careers.bdmReq5: I bɛ social media min tɛ sigi yɔrɔ kelen na, NFTw walima blockchain tekinoloji diyanye tiɲɛ na
careers.bdmComp: Nin baara bɛ sara jusigilan di min bɛ se ka sɔsɔ, ani OTE komisɔn sigicogo dan tɛ min na, min bɛ tali kɛ i bɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya minnu lana. Baarakɛla ɲumanbaw ka wari sɔrɔli dan tɛ.

careers.ambassadorAbout: I mana kɛ DeHub Tɔgɔla ye, i ye platform ɲɛda ni a kan ye i ka jɛkulu kɔnɔ. I ka baara ye ka DeHub kibaro jɛnsɛn sira bɛɛ fɛ i bɛ min na — social media, ɲɔgɔnye sɛbɛw, gaming ɲɛnajɛw, inivɛrisite dugukolow, ani fɔ ka taa a fɛ. Nin ye baara ye min sara bɛ sara kalo o kalo, a tɛ komisiyɔn kan; i bɛna sɔrɔ sabatilen sɔrɔ ka bonya ni platform ye ɲɔgɔn fɛ.

careers.ambassadorResp2: Ka i yɛrɛ don DeHub jɛkulu kɔnɔ app kan — ka post kɛ, ka hakilina fɔ, ka baro kɛ ni baarakɛla tɔw ye

careers.ambassadorResp4: Ka baarakɛla kuraw ni dabɔbagaw don platform kan i yɛrɛ ka mɔgɔw fɛ
careers.ambassadorResp5: Ka jɛkulu ka hakilinaw ni laɲiniw lase an ma walasa ka ko nata labɛn
careers.ambassadorReq1: Ka i yɛrɛ jira social media kan ni ɲɔgɔndɛmɛ tiɲɛnnen ye (tugubagaw hakɛ tɛ nafa ka tɛmɛ tiɲɛ kan)
careers.ambassadorReq2: Ka Web3, crypto, gaming walima dabɔbagaw ka laada diya i ye kosɛbɛ

staking.title: Staking
staking.subtitle: Wari bila ka tɔnɔ tilayɔrɔ, sara dɔgɔmanw, superpowers ani fɛn wɛrɛw sɔrɔ!
staking.stakeDesc: I ka token bila walasa ka sara sɔrɔ.
staking.dhbAcrossAllChains: Token minnu bɛ chain bɛɛ kan

staking.unlockBenefits: I ka token bila ka nafa barikamanw sɔrɔ
staking.profitShareDesc: Platform ka wari sɔrɔlen tilayɔrɔ sɔrɔ, min bɛ tila bilabagaw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. I ka bilali ka ca cogo o cogo, i ka sara tilayɔrɔ bɛ bonya ten.

staking.trendingBoosts: Trending barika — i ka fɛnw bɛ kɔrɔta

staking.increasedLimitsDesc: Bilali dakun kɔrɔtalenw bɛ jago dan bonya, dɛmɛ teliman, fɛn kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ani kalata fanga barikama di.
staking.earlyAccessDesc: Kɛ mɔgɔ fɔlɔ ye ka platform fɛn kuraw kɔrɔbɔ sani u ka se mɔgɔw bɛɛ ma. Bilabagaw bɛ beta ni baarakɛminɛn nataw sɔrɔ fɔlɔ.
staking.enhancedExperienceDesc: Baarakɛcogo ɲumanba diyabɔ ni bilali dan bonyalenw ani UI labɛncogo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
staking.airdropsDesc: Bilabagaw bɛ se ka token airdrop kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ani sara farankan sɔrɔ. I ka bilali ka ca cogo o cogo, i bɛ sɔrɔ ka caya ten.

earningsVs.noteYoutube: YouTube ye 45% ta jagofɛn sɔrɔ la kɔfɛ. A bɛ yɛlɛma kosɛbɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni siratigɛ ni filɛlikɛla ka jamana ye.
earningsVs.noteTwitch: Jagofɛn sɔrɔ dɔrɔn — subs ni bits tɛ a la, o de ka ca kosɛbɛ tuma caman na.
earningsVs.noteTiktok: Creator Rewards. A ka dɔgɔn kosɛbɛ filɛli kelen na; hakɛ caya de ye a bɛɛ ye.
earningsVs.noteReels: Bonus porogaramuw ye weleli dɔrɔn ye, ani u datugura siɲɛ caman.
earningsVs.footnote: Kɛlɛbagaw ka jatew ye jateminɛw ye ka bɔ baarakɛcogo hakɛw la minnu bɔra kɛnɛ kan, u tɛ sarali sɛgɛsɛgɛlenw ye. RPM yɛrɛ bɛ yɛlɛma kosɛbɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni siratigɛ, lamɛnnikɛlaw ka jamana ani filɛli waati ye, o la i ka sara kelen kelen bɛɛ yɛlɛma walisa a ka bɛn i ka sɔrɔ yɛrɛ ma. DeHub ka jate ye i ka tip sɔrɔ yɛrɛ ye min yɛlɛmana ni DHB sɔngɔ ye sisan, ani abonema, PPV ni butiki feereli tɛ a la. Filɛliw lajɛra i ka sɛbɛn kɔfɛ 100 la.

solana.unavailableBody: Nin minɛn tɛ i ka DeHub wari maralan konnɛgɛ mara. Don kokura walasa k'a lasegin, i ka Solana wari maralan fana bɛ segin n'a ye.
solana.explorerFailed: Solscan ma se ka da wuli
solana.fundingBody: Sɛbɛnniw, bonyaliw ani dayɛlɛliw Solana kan bɛ sara nin ladɛrɛsi la. SOL ci a ma ka bɔ sanni-fɛɛrɛ yɔrɔ walima wari maralan wɛrɛ la — SOL 0.01 ɲɔgɔn bɛ se ka sɛbɛnni caaman sara. A bɔra i ka DeHub wari maralan na, o de y'a to a bɛ segin minɛn o minɛn kan i donna a la.

solana.legacyBody: Porogaramu kɔrɔ dɔ ye Solana wari maralan wɛrɛ dilan min tun bɛ nin minɛn dɔrɔn kan. Wari bɛ a la halibi. Wari lataa sanfɛ ladɛrɛsi ma k'a to nin telefɔni bɛ i bolo — o konnɛgɛ tɛ se ka sɔrɔ yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la.

walletSetup.restoreMissing: Nin profili ka wari-mara tɛ nin telefɔni kan, o de kosɔn foyi tɛ se ka bolonɔ bila fɔlɔ. A ka lasegin-kuma walima a ka gundo-konnɛgɛ sɛbɛn walisa k'a lase yan.
walletSetup.writeThemDown: U sɛbɛn yɔrɔ dɔ la i kelen bɛ se ka taa min na. Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ min bɛ ni nin daɲɛw ye, i ka wari maralan bɛ o bolo — DeHub dɛmɛbaga tɛ se k'u lasegin wala k'u labɛn kokura.
walletSetup.noPhraseNoKey: Kuma tɛ yen, konnɛgɛ fana tɛ? O tuma nin wari maralan bɛ se ka da wuli minɛn dɔrɔn na min y'a dilan — fɛn si tɛ siti kan wala an fɛ min bɛ se k'a lasegin. Don o minɛn na n'a bɛ i bolo halibi.
walletSetup.resetExplainer: Nin bɛ wari maralan kura lakolon di i ka donni ma, ka i ka jate lataa a kan. A tɛ wari maralan kɔrɔ da wuli — nin telefɔni tɛ se, dehub.io tɛ se, an fana tɛ se — o la fɛn o fɛn bɛ a kɔnɔ, o bɛ to yen.

walletSetup.protectWallet: Walasa i kelen de ka se ka sɛbɛnni kɛ walima ka baara kɛ ni nin jate ye, i ka wari maralan lakana ni i ka minɛn bolonɔ walima tɛmɛsira ye.
walletSetup.ifYouUsedDehub: N'i delila ka baara kɛ ni dehub.io ye, a da wuli i ka ɔridinatɛri kan, don o cogo kelen na ni jate kelen na, ani
walletSetup.biometricExplainer: A da wuli ni i bolonɔ walima i ɲɛda ye — foyi tɛ sɛbɛn walima ka hakili la. Konnɛgɛ bɛ to nin telefɔni kan, o la an bɛna laseginni kuma daɲɛ 12 jira i la walasa i k'u sɛbɛn; o de ye sira kelen ye ka segin ka bɔ telefɔni wɛrɛ la, siti la, walima installation kura kɔfɛ. Tɛmɛsira sugandi o nɔ na, o tuma tɛmɛsira yɛrɛ de bɛ o baara kɛ.
walletSetup.biometricPrompt: Nin wari maralan lakananen don ni nin minɛn bolonɔ ye. I bolonɔ walima i ɲɛda sɛmɛntiya walasa ka taa ɲɛ.
walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Laseginni kuma daɲɛ 12 sɛbɛn, i ye min mara tuma min na i ye nin wari maralan dilan (walima a konnɛgɛ gundo, n'i y'a labɔ). A bɛ segin jate kelen kan, ani tɛmɛsira min b'i sigi duguma, o bɛ kɛ nɔɲɔgɔnna ye min bɛ baara kɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ kabini sisan.
walletSetup.addedPasswordRetry: N ye tɛmɛsira fara — a lajɛ tugun

walletSetup.confirmStartOver: Sɛmɛntiya ko i b'a fɛ ka daminɛ kokura ni wari maralan kura ye
walletSetup.understandOldWallet: N y'a faamu ko wari maraso kɔrɔ ni a kɔnɔfɛnw bɛɛ tɛna se n bolo tugun abada

walletSetup.legacyRecovered: An y'i ka jate kɔrɔ{{suffix}} sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani k'a ka wari maraso sɔrɔ. Tɔgɔ gundolen sigi walisa k'a lakana nin minan kan — nin telefɔni kan ani yɔrɔ bɛɛ, ka bɔ sisan.
walletSetup.newWalletPasswordMin: Wari maraso kura tɔgɔ gundolen (sɛbɛnden {{min}} dɔɔni dɔɔni)
walletSetup.deviceCheckCancelled: Minɛn lajɛli dabilara — foyi ma yɛlɛma.
walletSetup.phraseExplainer: I ka wallet bɛna lakana ni nin telefɔni ka farikolo taamasiyɛnw ye. O yɛlɛli bɛ baara kɛ nin telefɔni dɔrɔn kan — nin kuma 12 ninnu dɔrɔn de ye sira ye ka segin ni i ye DeHub bila kokura, walima ka telefɔni yɛlɛma, walima ka a tunun.
walletSetup.walletLeftBehind: Wari maralan min bɛ to kɔ: {{address}}
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Ni nin ma se tuguni, i ka wari maralan tɛmɛsira kɛ duguma walima "Kɛnɛma wallet don".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Nin wari maralan bɛ da wuli ni bolonɔ ye min maralen bɛ minɛn kelen dɔrɔn kan — telefɔni walima navigatɛri min kan a sigira. O konnɛgɛ tɛ nin telefɔni bolo, dehub.io fana t'a bolo: konnɛgɛ tɛ bɔ abada minɛn na min y'a dilan.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: Nin wari maralan lakananna ni passkey ye web kan ani tɛmɛsira maracogo si t'a la nuwaji la fɔlɔ. N'i ye wari maralan tɛmɛsira dɔ sigi dehub.io kan, a sɛbɛn yan — n'o tɛ, "Kɛnɛma wallet don" kɛ duguma.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Wari maralan dɔ bɛ nin jate bolo kaban, tɛmɛsira b'a lakana. A sɛbɛn walasa ka i ka wari maralan lasegin nin minɛn kan.
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Laseginni sɛbɛn dɔ bɛ nin jate bolo dehub.io kan. Laseginni kode daɲɛ 24 min dira i ma, o bɛ se ka nin wari maralan da wuli halibi. dehub.io da wuli ɔridinatɛri kan, i don cogo kelen na ni jate kelen ye, ka o kode kɛ — a bɛ wari maralan, ani i ka jate, lasegin i n'a fɔ u tun bɛ cogo min na.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Passkey da wulili kelen sɛbɛnnen bɛ nin jate ye dehub.io kan. Navigatɛri min b'a mara, dehub.io bɛ se ka nin wari maralan da wuli o la halibi.

walletSetup.loseFundsHead: Fɛn o fɛn bɛ wari maralan kɔrɔ kɔnɔ.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: A ka wari bɛ to {{address}} la blockchain kan — foyi tɛ musaka wala ka ta — nka k'u lamaga, o wari maralan ka laseginni kuma walima a konnɛgɛ gundo de ka kan. N'o si t'i bolo, mɔgɔ si tɛ se k'u sɔrɔ: i yɛrɛ tɛ, an fana tɛ. Ni i tɛ se ka konnɛgɛ bɔ minɛn na min y'a dilan, a kɔnɔfɛnw jate i n'a fɔ u tununna.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: Laseginni sɛbɛn min bɛ dehub.io kan, o bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ, o la o sira fana bɛ datugu.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: N'i ye laseginni kode daɲɛ 24 dɔ sigi dehub.io kan ka kɔrɔ, o bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ. An ma se ka a lajɛ ni kelen b'i bolo.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: Passkey minnu sɛbɛnnen bɛ dehub.io kan, olu bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: Passkey o passkey sɛbɛnnen bɛ dehub.io kan, olu bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ. An ma se ka a lajɛ ni dɔ b'i bolo.
walletSetup.keepAccountHead: I ka jate, a bɛ cogo min na tigitigi.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Tɔgɔ, profili, bila, hakilinaw, tugubagaw, badjiw ani tariku bɛɛ bɛ taa wari maralan kura kan. Jate kelen don — mɔgɔ si man kan ka i ɲini kokura.

walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Baro, kunnafoniw, taamasiyɛnw, bila maralenw ani filɛli tariku bɛ na i fɛ. Foyi tɛ jɔsi ani mɔgɔ wɛrɛ si tɛ se ka u la foyi kalan.

walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Telefɔni nimɔrɔ kelen, imɛli walima Google jate kelen, digili kelen kelen. Wari maralan min bɛ donni kɔ, o de bɛ falen, donni yɛrɛ tɛ.

walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Wari maralan adrɛsi sɛbɛnnen bɛ nin jate ye, nka maracogo si t'a la nin telefɔni bɛ se ka min kɛ — a lakananna ni bolonɔ walima passkey ye web kan (o da wulili bɛ to navigatɛri kɔnɔ, a tɛ na yan), walima donni kɔrɔ dɔ nin telefɔni kan jɔra sani a ka ban.

commonGround.reminderBody: O kama, an ka ɲi k'a ɲini k'a lɔn ko an ka ɲi ka mun lo kɛ walisa ka se k'an yɛrɛ tanga o ma. N'i ye ɲiningali dɔ kɛ, o be se ka kɛ sababu ye i be se ka mɔgɔ sabanan sugandi yɔrɔ dɔ la.
